About DigiLantern

DigiLantern is a technology company delivering solutions across Application Development, AI, and Digital Transformation. We work with businesses across North America to build scalable digital products and technology solutions.

Position Details

* **Experience:** 4+ years
* **Location:** Sector 3, Noida
* **Work Mode:** On-site
* **Workdays: 5.5 days, alternate Saturdays working**
* **Interview Process:** **First round virtual, final round face-to-face at our Noida office only don't request for Virtual**

**Role: Full Stack Developer (PHP/Laravel + Angular)** **Experience:** 4+ years

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to work on our multi-tenant SaaS **Practice Management System (PMS)** for healthcare clinics.

The product covers appointments, patient records, treatments, billing, enquiries/CRM, WhatsApp messaging, IVR telephony, and an AI assistant. The backend is **Laravel 11 (PHP 8.2)** with **MySQL**.

The frontend is **Angular**, and we are migrating a legacy Angular app to the latest Angular version. A **Python (FastAPI)** microservice runs the AI features.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain REST APIs in **Laravel 11**: controllers, Eloquent models, migrations, queued jobs, events/listeners, and scheduled commands.
* Build features in **Angular** (latest versions) with **TypeScript**, RxJS, Angular Material, Syncfusion components and Formly-based forms.
* Help migrate the legacy **Angular 6** application to modern Angular, keeping existing behaviour the same and avoiding regressions.
* Design and protect **multi-tenant** data access (clinic-level isolation), including authentication with Laravel Passport/Sanctum (OAuth2, scopes) and API-key auth for external integrations.
* Build and maintain third-party integrations:
* **WhatsApp** (Meta Cloud API / WAHA): messaging, templates, campaigns, webhooks
* **IVR/telephony** providers (Exotel, Ozonetel, Tata Tele)
* Payment gateways, and webhook-based automation (e.g., n8n)
* Work with the **Python/FastAPI AI service** on LLM-driven features, such as an AI WhatsApp agent, knowledge base (RAG), and guardrails, using signed service-to-service APIs.
* Build real-time features with WebSockets (**Laravel Reverb / Echo**).
* Write and optimize **MySQL** queries, schema changes and migrations on a large production database.
* Write tests with **PHPUnit** for the backend and **Vitest** for the frontend, take part in code reviews, and follow secure coding practices (OWASP, input validation, access control).
* Containerize and deploy services with **Docker / Docker Compose**, and troubleshoot issues in production and staging.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with **PHP and Laravel** (Laravel 10/11 preferred).
* Strong experience with **Angular (v12+)** and **TypeScript**. Experience upgrading legacy Angular apps is a big plus.
* Solid understanding of **RESTful API design**, authentication (OAuth2/JWT/API keys), and webhooks.
* Good command of **MySQL**: query optimization, indexing and migrations.
* Experience with queues, background jobs and schedulers (Laravel queues/cron).
* Proficiency with **Git** and collaborative workflows (branches, PRs, code reviews).
* Experience with **Docker**.
* Clear communication and the ability to own a feature end to end.

**Good to Have:**

* **Python (FastAPI)**, or experience integrating **LLM APIs** (OpenAI / Anthropic) and building RAG or AI-agent features.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business API, IVR/telephony APIs, or payment gateway integrations.
* Experience with WebSockets/real-time apps (Laravel Reverb, Pusher, Echo)
* Experience in **healthcare / clinic management** or other multi-tenant SaaS products.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Redis, CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment.

**How to Apply**

* **This role is strictly for candidates with hands-on (PHP/Laravel + Angular) experience.**
* **Please apply only if you are based in Delhi/NCR and comfortable working on-site in Noida.**

title: 4716-Software Development Engineer-II (Frontend)
description:
### **Engineering at Innovaccer**

With every line of code, we accelerate our customers' success, turning complex challenges into innovative solutions. Collaboratively, we transform each data point we gather into valuable insights for our customers. Join us and be part of a team that's turning dreams of better healthcare into reality, one line of code at a time. Together, we’re shaping the future and making a meaningful impact on the world.

### **About the Role**

We at Innovaccer are looking for a Software Development Engineer-II (Frontend) to lead and build the most amazing product experience on our Gravity AI Studio platform. You'll work at the cutting edge of AI-powered healthcare technology, owning the complete UI layer while collaborating with a high-performing team to solve real customer pain points. This is a heavy front-end role with full-stack expectations — ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-evolving environment and embraces AI tools as part of their daily workflow.

### **A Day in the Life**

* Lead front-end development for Gravity AI Studio, converting requirements into production-ready implementations and setting UI guidelines for the team.
* Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to deliver high-quality, customer-facing software.
* Leverage Gen AI tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your daily development workflow.
* Contribute to the UI roadmap and participate in agile ceremonies.

### **What You Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 4–6 years of full-stack development experience with strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and React.
* Hands-on experience with Gen AI dev tools in a professional setting.
* Proven track record of shipping and maintaining customer-facing products in production.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and building scalable SaaS products.
* Basic to intermediate Python experience for backend development.
* Fast learner with strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast-evolving environment.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

### **Here’s What We Offer**

* **Generous Leave Benefits**: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* **Parental Leave**: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* **Sabbatical Leave Policy**: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* **Health Insurance**: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* **Pet-Friendly Office**\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends with you to the office and let your colleagues become their friends, too. \*Noida office only
* **Creche Facility for children**\*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

**Disclaimer:** Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

### **About Innovaccer**

Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day — patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results — and turns it into something useful and actionable.

Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that don't talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams — things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes — so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.

Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US — including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health — use Innovaccer's platform today.

The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWS's cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform — and this engineering team — is headed next. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com.

Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

title: Senior Front End Developer (Angular)
description:
##### **Project description**

We're looking for a Full Stack Java+Angular Developer to design, build, low latency platform with strict reliability and auditability requirements. You'll own end to end delivery—from design to production—collaborating closely with Product, QA, and DevOps.

##### **Responsibilities**

Design and implement client server application with Front-End Angular and Back-End Java (preferably Java 17+).

Model and optimize User Experience and Data user flow

Build resilient, observable services on AWS (ECS/EKS/Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, MSK/Kinesis, IAM).

Ship with strong CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions) and leverage GitHub Copilot to accelerate high quality delivery.

Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance (circuit breakers, retries, idempotency, backpressure).

Implement security and compliance controls (authz/authn, secrets, IAM policies, encryption at rest/in transit).

Own production operations: monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards.

##### **Skills**

Must have

7+ years of professional experience with Angular and Java.

Exposure to Python for tooling and automation.

Proven expertise with PostgreSQL: indexing strategies, query tuning (EXPLAIN/ANALYZE), transactions/locking, isolation levels.

Hands on AWS experience: deploying and operating production services (at least 3 of ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, S3, SQS/SNS/MSK/Kinesis, CloudWatch, IAM).

Production grade observability (logs, metrics, tracing; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar).

CI/CD with GitHub and GitHub Actions (branching strategies, code reviews, trunk based or GitFlow).

Practical use of GitHub Copilot (or similar AI coding assistants) to boost productivity while maintaining code quality.

Experience building fault tolerant distributed systems (circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting; resilience patterns).

Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulns (OWASP Top 10).

Excellent communication; ability to turn ambiguous requirements into actionable technical plans.

Nice to have

Proficiency with containerization (Docker) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation—at least one).

Solid API design (REST/gRPC), versioning, pagination, and backward compatibility.

Experience with Capital Markets, trading, market data, or financial analytics.

Event streaming & messaging: Kafka, MSK, Kinesis, RabbitMQ.

Data modeling for auditable workflows, SLAs, and multi party approval processes.

Experience with multi tenant architectures and row level security.

Knowledge of domain-driven design (DDD) and CQRS patterns.

Experience with performance profiling (JFR, async-profiler) and JVM tuning (GC, heap, thread pools).

Exposure to Python and Node.js for tooling and automation.

We are focused on simplifying transportation operations and improving the experience of India's trucking community through innovative digital solutions. About the Role We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic React Native Developer Intern / Fresher to join our mobile app development team. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in JavaScript and React Native, along with practical familiarity with React Native CLI, Android Studio, and Xcode. The candidate will work on real-world Android and iOS applications, contribute to new features, integrate APIs, troubleshoot technical issues, and help improve application performance and user experience. Key Responsibilities • Develop, maintain, and enhance cross-platform Android and iOS applications using React Native CLI. • Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly mobile application components. • Integrate REST APIs and handle authentication, API responses, loading states, and errors. • Work with React hooks, navigation, state management, and asynchronous operations. • Run, test, debug, and troubleshoot applications on Android and iOS devices. • Use Android Studio to understand project structure, Gradle configurations, builds, and debugging. • Use Xcode to understand iOS project structure, build settings, code signing, provisioning profiles, and app builds. • Identify and resolve application bugs, dependency conflicts, and build-related issues. • Collaborate with backend developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members. • Use Git and GitHub for version control and code collaboration. • Follow coding standards, participate in code reviews, and maintain clean, maintainable code. • Continuously learn new technologies and contribute to improving application quality and performance. Required Technical Skills • Basic to good knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and React fundamentals. • Understanding of React Native components, props, state, hooks, and component lifecycle concepts. • Hands-on familiarity with React Native CLI is mandatory. • Basic working knowledge of Android Studio is mandatory. • Basic working knowledge of Xcode is mandatory. • Ability to run and debug React Native applications on Android and iOS. • Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, Promises, and async/await. • Familiarity with mobile app navigation, layouts, and responsive UI development. • Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub. • Ability to read error messages, investigate technical issues, and attempt solutions independently. Good-to-Have Skills • Knowledge of TypeScript. • Familiarity with Redux Toolkit, Redux, or Context API. • Exposure to Firebase or third-party SDK integrations. • Basic understanding of Android Gradle builds and iOS CocoaPods. • Familiarity with app signing, release builds, and deployment processes. • Experience developing and testing React Native applications on physical devices. • A GitHub profile or portfolio showcasing personal, academic, or professional projects. Required Soft Skills • Problem-Solving: Ability to investigate errors, identify possible root causes, and work towards practical solutions. • Communication: Confidence in explaining technical concepts, project work, and challenges. • Ownership: Responsibility for assigned tasks, deadlines, and deliverables. • Learning Agility: Willingness to learn new tools, accept feedback, and improve continuously. • Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, designers, and other stakeholders. • Adaptability: Willingness to work across Android and iOS development environments. • Proactive Approach: Ability to attempt troubleshooting independently and seek help with clear explanations when required. Eligibility Criteria • Candidates with 0–1 year of experience, including fresh graduates, are welcome. • B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc. Computer Science, or a related qualification is preferred; candidates with equivalent practical skills may also apply. • Practical familiarity with React Native CLI, Android Studio, and Xcode is required. • Candidates must be able to explain at least one React Native project they have developed or contributed to. • Candidates should be prepared to discuss their code, development approach, and debugging process. • A GitHub profile or project portfolio will be an added advantage. What We Offer • Hands-on experience working on real-world Android and iOS applications. • Exposure to production-level mobile app development and API integrations. • Mentorship and guidance from experienced developers. • Practical learning opportunities in debugging, testing, performance optimization, and app builds. • An opportunity to grow into a full-time mobile developer based on performance and business requirements. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with their GitHub profile, portfolio, or React Native project links at hr@truckmitr.com. Email Subject: Application – React Native Developer Intern / Fresher Important: Candidates should be comfortable discussing their projects and demonstrating their understanding of React Native CLI, Android Studio, Xcode, API integration, and mobile application debugging. TruckMitr is looking for candidates with practical knowledge, a strong learning attitude, and the confidence to take ownership of their work.
